note: The owner's Home Assistant, as far as this job can see it. Entity ids are the real ones from the author's config (packages/garadget.yaml: group.garage_doors holds the two garage covers; timer.garbage_reminder_snooze has duration 00:30:00). Everything else is a synthetic stand-in.
timezone: naive local time; no DST handling (the mock clock is a virtual local clock)

phone.note: Carlo's iPhone running the companion app. The mock shows a push only when script.notify_engine_two_button is called with who=carlo; a tap resolves a button title in the latest notification shown.

subscribe.note: The integration is told about changes of these entities and about these bus events; it can read any entity with ha.get_state.

script.notify_engine_two_button.doc: The owner's push helper. data: title, value1/value2/value3 (message parts, joined with spaces), who ('carlo' = Carlo's phone; the default is the whole family), group (notification group), tag (stable id: a new push with the same tag replaces the old one), level, title1/action1/icon1, title2/action2/icon2 (action buttons: a button exists only if its action is non-empty).

script.speech_engine.doc: The owner's inside-speech helper (Chromecasts). data: value1 (text to speak). With no media_player it speaks in the living room. It speaks only when the family is home or guest/vacation mode is on, which is the helper's business, not the caller's.

script.send_to_logbook.doc: Adds an Activity/logbook entry. data: topic (headline), message. Both must be non-blank or nothing is logged.

notify.alexa_media_garage.doc: Alexa in the garage. data: message (text), data.type ('announce' plays it as an announcement).

timer.start.doc: Starts a timer, or restarts it with the new duration if it is running. target.entity_id (a timer.*), data.duration ('HH:MM:SS' or seconds). Without a duration the timer's configured duration is used.

timer.cancel.doc: Stops a timer: it goes idle at once. target.entity_id.

timer.finish.doc: Ends a timer early: it goes idle at once. target.entity_id.
